episode_title: Season 2026 Episode 5. Meet Matthew Adams -- Spiritual Seeker and New Podcaster!

real_qa.q: What is a darkness retreat and how does it work in practice?
real_qa.r: A darkness retreat involves staying in a room with blackout material covering all doors and windows, plus an additional layer covering the entire wall to prevent any light from entering. Matthew Adams spent 17 days in such a retreat in Mexico in 2022, and returned for another 14-day retreat three years later. Ancient indigenous cultures have used darkness retreats to develop shamanic abilities in children and to facilitate healing.
real_qa.requete: darkness retreat how does it work

real_qa.q: What did Matthew Adams experience during his first 17-day darkness retreat in Mexico?
real_qa.r: During darkness retreats, participants lose awareness of their physical body and expand consciousness to connect with more information. Matthew describes experiencing things outside normal waking consciousness, similar to out-of-body experiences he had as a child when lying in complete darkness. He credits four Dr. Joe Dispenza retreats in 2020-2021 as preparation for understanding these altered states of consciousness.
real_qa.requete: Matthew Adams darkness retreat Mexico experience

real_qa.q: How did ancient indigenous cultures use darkness retreats for spiritual development?
real_qa.r: Indigenous cultures used darkness retreats to identify children showing signs of becoming shamans, keeping them in darkness for most of their childhood to develop their shamanic abilities. Darkness retreats were also used in communities to facilitate healing when individuals needed it. Modern hospitals now integrate shamans working alongside Western medicine, blending these ancient practices with contemporary healthcare.

real_qa.q: What is Curious with Matt podcast about and what is its tagline?
real_qa.r: Curious with Matt is Matthew Adams' developing podcast with the tagline 'Where Curiosity Becomes Connected.' The podcast explores how curiosity creates genuine human connection and aims to bring back lessons and knowledge from transformative spiritual experiences that most people cannot access firsthand.

real_qa.q: What competition is Matthew Adams participating in and what is the prize?
real_qa.r: Matthew Adams reached the quarterfinals of the National Top Host Competition, where he is competing for the chance to make a six-episode podcast with iHeartRadio. Voting takes place at tophost.org/2026/Matthew Adams, with the voting round closing on November 26th.
real_qa.requete: National Top Host Competition Matthew Adams iHeartRadio

guest.bio_context: Matthew Adams is a Detroit native living in Atlanta who has spent significant time on spiritual retreats and training in martial arts. In 2022, he completed a 17-day darkness retreat in Mexico, followed by a 14-day retreat three years later. He also trained in kung fu and meditation in Thailand for four months and spent six months training in China. These experiences shaped his vision for his podcast exploring travel, spirituality, and personal transformation.

real_quote: Curiosity does create connection—when we're curious, we get to see that we're more alike than when we are different.
